correctness.rationale: Stationarity of X−x=Y gives Ey=0. Stationarity of X²−x² gives E[xY]=−E[y²]/2. Stationarity of XY−xy gives E[xy]=E[xY]+E[y²]=E[y²]/2; hence Cov(x,y)=Var(y)/2. Taking expectations in Y=(1+eps)y+kx(x−1)+mu xy gives k E[x(x−1)]+mu Var(y)/2=0. When k>0,mu<0, Var(y)=0 forces y=Y=0 and x∈{0,1} a.s.; otherwise E[(x−1/2)²]=1/4−mu Var(y)/(2k)>1/4, so a positive fraction of mass lies outside x∈[0,1]. Covariance PSD yields Vx>=Vy/4. At nonzero-variance equality, x−E x=y/2 a.s.; invariance of same relation at image and X=x+Y force Y=−y, X−E x=−(x−E x), so T²=id a.s. This is exact symbolic stationarity and Cauchy rigidity, not an inference from numerical orbits; an actual two-cycle in the sign regime k=2,mu=−1,eps=−1 realizes the reflection equality.
